title: Waves: Amplitude and Wavelength
seo_title: Grade 4 Waves Worksheets: Amplitude, Wavelength and How Waves Move Energy
standard_text: Develop a model of waves to describe patterns in terms of amplitude and wavelength and that waves can cause objects to move.
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 science worksheets on waves (NGSS 4-PS4-1): crests and troughs, amplitude and wavelength on wave diagrams, and why a floating object bobs up and down. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_sub: Amplitude is the height from the rest line to a crest. Wavelength is the distance from crest to crest.

faq.q: What is the difference between amplitude and wavelength?
faq.a: Amplitude is how tall a wave is, from the rest line to a crest. Wavelength is how long it is, from one crest to the next.

faq.q: Do waves carry water to the shore?
faq.a: No. Waves carry energy. The water mostly moves up and down in place as the wave passes.
The wave with the larger amplitude carries more energy.

items.q: A toy boat is at rest on a pool. A friend makes waves at the other end. What makes the boat start bobbing?
items.e: Waves carry energy across the pool and make the boat move.

items.q: Which waves could knock over a sand castle at the beach?
items.e: Larger amplitude means more energy to push sand.

items.q: Waves pass under a small toy boat floating on a pond. How does it move?
c: along with the waves all the way to the shore
it does not move at all
items.e: A wave moves energy, not the water. The water and the floating object go up and down as the wave passes.

items.q: A ribbon is tied to the middle of a jump rope. Waves move along the rope. How does the ribbon move?
c: along the rope to the end
around in circles in the air
items.e: Each part of the rope moves up and down as the wave passes.

items.q: A stadium crowd does “the wave.” Each person stands up and sits down. Where does each person end up?
c: at the other end of the stadium
items.e: The wave pattern travels around the stadium, but the people only move up and down.

items.e: Bigger up-and-down motion makes taller crests.
